title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
summary: Refuses the stream-output pipeline that crashes D3DMetal's shader converter, and lets the game offer DLSS.

credits.name: tholtman1-del
credits.note: The diagnosis of the black screen and the rule that refuses the pipeline (MIT).

excerpts.note: tholtman1-del's rule: a geometry-shader pipeline that streams out, or has no pixel shader, is refused.
The refusal: E_INVALIDARG before the pipeline reaches Apple's shader converter, which crashed on it and left the game deadlocked on a black screen.
